setup_sql: CREATE TABLE bench_numeric_rollup AS SELECT CASE WHEN i%97=0 THEN NULL ELSE i%5 END AS g, CASE WHEN i%101=0 THEN NULL ELSE i%7 END AS h, CASE WHEN i%103=0 THEN NULL ELSE i%3 END AS k, CASE WHEN i%11=0 THEN NULL ELSE (i%10001-5000)::numeric / 100 END AS v, CASE WHEN i%13=0 THEN NULL ELSE (i%7919-3959)::numeric / 3 END AS w, CASE WHEN i%17=0 THEN NULL ELSE (i%60001-30000)::int2 END AS qty FROM generate_series(1,250000) s(i)
